name: manual_5639c5
claim: When git push fails with authentication or invalid password errors on macOS due to a conflicting exported GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable, run: env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh auth setup-git && env -u GITHUB_TOKEN git push --force-with-lease origin <branch>. Unsetting GITHUB_TOKEN forces git to use valid macOS Keychain / gh CLI credentials while --force-with-lease prevents overwriting unexpected remote commits.

decisions.notes: Discovered during PR #354 and PR #315 force-pushes when exported GITHUB_TOKEN in environment broke git push with password authentication error.

rationale: Discovered during PR #354 and PR #315 force-pushes when exported GITHUB_TOKEN in environment broke git push with password authentication error.
